entitáshoz vagy kapcsolathoz anchorolható lokális gráfkereséssel

nevezz meg legalább egy ilyen részkérdést, még akkor is, ha a kezdeti

ami nincs a megadott riportrészletekben.

Csak az alábbi JSON-t add vissza, mást nem:
{"initial_answer": "<string>", "subquestions": ["<string>", "<string>"?]}

Kérdés: Who won the 2021 Formula One World Drivers' Championship?

Közösségi riportok:
[riport 111] The 2020 Formula One season featured notable performances from drivers such as Charles Leclerc, who finished eighth in the standings and had a top-five finish at the Portuguese Grand Prix (N001, N004). Lewis Hamilton won the championship, securing his seventh title, while Max Verstappen and Valtteri Bottas also achieved significant results throughout the season (N106, E111). The season included various Grand Prix events, such as the Austrian Grand Prix, where Leclerc finished eighth and Hamilton claimed victory (N002, E001, E082).
  - Charles Leclerc finished eighth in the 2020 Formula One standings and had a top-five finish at the Portuguese Grand Prix.
  - Lewis Hamilton won the 2020 World Drivers' Championship, marking his seventh title.
  - The Austrian Grand Prix was a significant event in the 2020 season, with Hamilton winning and Leclerc finishing eighth.

[riport 3] The community focuses on Charles Leclerc's performance across multiple Formula One seasons, highlighting his achievements such as back-to-back poles in 2021, being runner-up in 2022, and winning the Monaco Grand Prix in 2024. It also notes his consistent podium finishes and pole positions in 2023, alongside various race results from significant Grand Prix events.
  - In the 2021 season, Charles Leclerc achieved back-to-back poles at the Monaco and Azerbaijan Grands Prix.
  - Charles Leclerc was the runner-up in the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 2022.
  - In 2024, Leclerc won the Monaco Grand Prix and was leading the World Drivers' Championship.
  - In the 2023 season, Leclerc had five pole positions and six podiums, finishing third in the championship.

[riport 12] The community focuses on the 2019 Formula One season, highlighting key events and achievements, particularly those of Charles Leclerc, who signed with Ferrari and won the FIA Pole Trophy. The Canadian Grand Prix is a significant race within this season, featuring notable performances from drivers like Leclerc, Hamilton, and Boutsen.
  - Charles Leclerc signed for Ferrari and achieved multiple victories in the 2019 season, becoming the youngest recipient of the FIA Pole Trophy.
  - The Canadian Grand Prix, held at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, was a notable race in the 2019 season where Charles Leclerc qualified and finished third.
  - Thierry Boutsen recorded a victory at the Canadian Grand Prix.
